ServiceId.description: Unique identifier of the Service that is reserved.

GroupId.description: Unique identifier of the Reservation group.

Number.description: Confirmation number of the reservation in Mews.

ChannelNumber.description: Number of the reservation within the Channel (i.e. OTA, GDS, CRS, etc) in case the reservation group originates there (e.g. Booking.com confirmation number).

ChannelManagerNumber.description: Unique number of the reservation within the reservation group.

ChannelManagerGroupNumber.description: Number of the reservation group within a Channel manager that transferred the reservation from Channel to Mews.

ChannelManager.description: Name of the Channel manager (e.g. AvailPro, SiteMinder, TravelClick, etc).

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the reservation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the reservation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

CancelledUtc.description: Cancellation date and time in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

StartUtc.description: Start of the reservation in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format. This is either the scheduled reservation start time, or the actual customer check-in time if this is earlier than the scheduled start time.

EndUtc.description: End of the reservation (departure) in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

ReleasedUtc.description: Date when the optional reservation is released in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

RequestedCategoryId.description: Identifier of the requested Resource category.

AssignedSpaceLocked.description: Whether the reservation is locked to the assigned Space and cannot be moved.

AssignedResourceLocked.description: Whether the reservation is locked to the assigned Resource and cannot be moved.

BusinessSegmentId.description: Identifier of the reservation Business segment.

CompanyId.description: Identifier of the Company on behalf of which the reservation was made.

TravelAgencyId.description: Identifier of the Company that mediated the reservation.

AvailabilityBlockId.description: Unique identifier of the Availability block the reservation is assigned to.

VoucherId.description: Unique identifier of the Voucher that has been used to create reservation.

CreditCardId.description: Unique identifier of the Credit card.

AdultCount.description: Count of adults the reservation was booked for.

ChildCount.description: Count of children the reservation was booked for.

PersonCounts.description: Number of people per age category the reservation was booked for.

OwnerId.description: Unique identifier of the Customer or Company who owns the reservation.

CustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the Customer who owns the reservation.

BookerId.description: Unique identifier of the Customer on whose behalf the reservation was made.

CompanionIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Customer`s that will use the resource.
